svg.title: How Maple works: mount, comment, fix, gate
svg.desc: A four-panel pixel animation. Mount: Clawd throws a leaf and a sand castle rises under it. Comment: review leaves drift down onto the castle. Fix: the leaves fly to a line and turn green one by one while Clawd types; one is missed and falls, then is fixed on a second pass. Gate: the gate holds with one open, the missed one goes, the gate says go, its doors open and Clawd walks through.
